# AudioRecorderElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Video / audio capture

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement> CreateAudioRecorder( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement> CreateCompactAudioRecorder( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement> CreateAudioRecorderWithPlayback( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement(const std::string& identifier = "AudioRecorder", float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 400, float h = 72);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onRecordStarted` | `std::function<void()> onRecordStarted` | _Record started_ |
| `onRecordStopped` | `std::function<void()> onRecordStopped` | _Record stopped_ |
| `onBufferReady` | `std::function<void(std::shared_ptr<UCAudio>)> onBufferReady` | _Buffer ready_ |
| `onSaved` | `std::function<void(const std::string& filePath)> onSaved` | _Saved_ |
| `onSaveCancelled` | `std::function<void()> onSaveCancelled` | _Save cancelled_ |
| `onDiscarded` | `std::function<void()> onDiscarded` | _Discarded_ |
| `onPermissionChanged` | `std::function<void(MicrophonePermission)> onPermissionChanged` | _Permission changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
